qa_pairs.question: What resource provides a CVMFS tutorial from the 2021 Easybuild User Meeting?
qa_pairs.answer: The "[https://cvmfs-contrib.github.io/cvmfs-tutorial-2021/ 2021-01-26 CVMFS Tutorial]" from the Easybuild User Meeting 2021 provides a CVMFS tutorial, with associated tutorial slides available [https://cvmfs-contrib.github.io/cvmfs-tutorial-2021/eum21-cvmfs-tutorial-slides.pdf here].

qa_pairs.question: Which article illustrates the Compute Canada approach to distributing research applications for users, and what is notable about its described deployment?
qa_pairs.answer: The article "[https://towardsdatascience.com/unlimited-scientific-libraries-and-applications-in-kubernetes-instantly-b69b192ec5e5 2021-09-27 Unlimited scientific libraries and applications in Kubernetes, instantly!]" illustrates the Compute Canada approach to distributing research applications for users, though the deployment described in the article is only used for a single demo cluster and utilizes CephFS instead of CVMFS.

qa_pairs.question: What is the purpose of EESSI, as described in the Journal of Software: Practice and Experience?
qa_pairs.answer: As described in the article "[https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/spe.3075 2022-02-16 EESSI: A cross-platform ready-to-use optimized scientific software stack]", EESSI illustrates an extension to the Compute Canada approach for distributing software, aimed at a broader research community and providing wider hardware support.
